title: Tech Labs v. SoftServe Inc
text: The plaintiff, Tech Labs, filed a suit for breach of contract and damages against the defendant, SoftServe Inc, for failure to deliver customised software by the agreed date. The parties had entered into a software development agreement for a consideration of Rs 2,50,00,000. The defendant delivered a product that was deficient and did not meet the agreed specifications. The breach of contract was established through expert testimony comparing the delivered product against the technical specifications appended to the agreement. The court examined whether specific performance should be ordered. Since the software can be developed by another vendor, damages are an adequate remedy and specific performance is not granted. The defendant is directed to refund the advance consideration of Rs 1,25,00,000 and pay damages of Rs 75,00,000 for the additional cost of re-development. Breach of contract is thus compensated.
